headline: Public hearings on $10,149,973 airport building bond, $7,861,647 and $9,099,330 school roof bonds, and several handicapped parking requests.
summary: The meeting covers public hearings on an airport building bond, two school roof bonds, and handicapped parking and stop sign requests. It also includes pending matters, ordinances, committee reports, tabled matters, and new appointments and resolutions.
